sources.entry: JustTags - JustTags in a macOS app for working with BERTLV EMV tags.

summary.one_liner: JustTags is a macOS app for decoding, filtering, diffing and copying BER-TLV EMV tags from base64 or hex input.
summary.what_it_does: The app decodes BER-TLV EMV tag data given as base64 or hex strings into a readable list of tags. Decoded tags can be filtered by tag, name, or description. For specific tags such as 9F33 and 95, it fully decodes the tag value. It shows extra tag info including source, format, and kernel. Users can select tags and copy them as a hex string, and compare two tag lists against each other. Window tabs can be renamed. The README also describes command-line input through a custom justtags:// URL scheme, with a shell function that pipes data into the app.
use_cases: inspect BER-TLV payloads from hex or base64
filter and copy TLV tags as hex
pipe tag data from terminal into a macOS viewer
how_to_run: git clone (repository URL not included in the README)
Build and run with Command + R in Xcode
stack: Swift (inferred from Xcode; not named in README)
notable: Custom justtags:// URL scheme lets command-line tools open tag data directly in the app
Shell pipe integration via a justtags function in .zshrc or .bashrc
Side-by-side diff of two BER-TLV tag lists
Per-tag full value decoding for tags like 9F33 and 95
caveats: macOS only; built and run through Xcode
The clone command in the README is incomplete and gives no repository URL
